hypothesis: Earlier interpretation of public information can reduce time until useful physical aid, compared with competent finite conventional review.
fairness: Same raw public bytes, metadata, directory, formal-report delay, consented stock, fleet, field checks, dispatch reviews and physical world. Neither controller receives evaluator gold. Explicit structured requests and repost grouping are free in all arms.

references.B5: Conventional shared planner with free structured parsing plus finite human source review
references.B6: Real configured model perception, targeted confirmations and deterministic batching
references.B8: Stronger free broad keyword/location discovery, then the same targeted confirmations and batching
references.B9: Same configured model as a general tool-using disaster-response investigator: raw source batches, no specialized semantic preprocessor, same operational tools and reviewed physical response
references.B0: Extraction disconnected: formal observations only, same competent allocator

clocks: World travel/communication/review delays are modeled. Model availability is charged at max(declared latency, actual measured provider time). Human attention duration/workers are sensitivity parameters, not measured field productivity. SQL/HTTP wall overhead is separately reported, not sped up with the simulation clock.
negatives: Zero human-reading delay, immediate formal reports, failures, unserved needs and no advantage against a stronger keyword baseline must remain visible.
verification: Requests and operational owner reviews return pending receipts. The same finite field and owner queues progress while trucks move; submitting a review never advances the whole world synchronously to its approval. No controller must wait for all inquiries before acting on an already received need.
generalAgentScope: B9 is this explicit finite general-agent reference implementation, not all possible agents. It receives the same public sources, free structured parsing, approved policy, deterministic planner, owners, model configuration and total call/cost cap. The general agent chooses its own queries and drafts; no observer facts or specialized perception receipt are supplied.
name: primary
orchestration: Two zero-inference worlds in parallel, then one paid world at a time. Same physical resources, modeled delays, seeds and scoped authority in every arm. Every declared outcome including failures retained.
stop: All declared worlds retained. Existing physical-cohort completion is distinct from K22 source-recovery.
